newsitem.title: USA: Centennial Cellular stake lifted by Gabelli.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Cellular stake lifted by Gabelli.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Tuesday it raised its stake in Centennial Cellular Corp to 989,300 common shares, or six percent from five percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 81,000 common shares bought between October 23 and December 23 at prices ranging from $10.9063 to $14 per share.
The New Canaan, Conn., based company is involved with the acquisition, operation and investment in celluar telephone systems throughout the United States.
In addition, it owns and operates paging, specialized mobile radio and conventional mobile telephone businesses.
